page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a dedicated cloud server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed by the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 32 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The configuration includes 128.0 GB of system RAM, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

The primary hardware feature of the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is its bundled local storage. It integrates 94,489 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) storage attached directly to the host. System network interface capabilities provide a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance does not include discrete GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Providing nearly 95 TB of integrated HDD storage gives the instance a high physical storage density per virtual compute unit. This design eliminates the requirement for external network-attached storage when managing bulk datasets. However, using HDD media instead of solid-state drives introduces latency and IOPS limitations for random read and write operations. Resource allocation prioritizes cost-effective bulk capacity over extreme CPU single-thread speed or fast disk access.

With its combination of 32 vCPUs, 128 GB memory, and high local storage volume, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is structured for storage-heavy application environments. Suitable use cases include big data archiving, log aggregation, continuous system backups, and distributed file system nodes that require high capacity over random I/O performance.
